camel_example: aliyun iot QuerySpeechPushJobDevice --region cn-hangzhou --PageId 1 --Status SUCCESS --PageSize 20 --IotInstanceId 'iot-06000000' --JobCode tBUm00000000000000000000000QPGT --DeviceName test
description_en: Queries devices under a specified corpus push task
description_zh: 查询指定语料推送任务下的设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-speech-push-job-device --job-code tBUm00000000000000000000000QPGT --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --device-name test --status SUCCESS --iot-instance-id iot-06000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySpeechPushJobDevice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the push task. The Data field returned after a successful call to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html is the push task ID
parameters.help_zh: 推送任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html成功后返回的**Data**字段为推送任务ID
parameters.name: job_code

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en:
The push task status. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried. Valid values:

RUNNING: Running.
SENDING: Sending.
CANCEL: Canceled.
SUCCESS: Succeeded.
TIMEOUT: Timed out
parameters.help_zh:
推送任务状态，不传则查询所有类型。

RUNNING：运行中。
SENDING：正在发送。
CANCEL：取消。
SUCCESS：成功。
TIMEOUT：超时
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
